title: Wild Shore

[[Image:Wild Shore.jpg|thumb|300px|Bloodsail Buccaneers' ships moored at the Wild Shore.]]
'''Wild Shore''' is the southernmost coastline of the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], and is home to the [[Bloodsail Buccaneers]] and their fleet. [[Gorlash]] can be found along the shore nearby.
